psychological_meaning: Gurkha, a muted olive-green, evokes feelings of calm, stability, and connection to nature. It suggests reliability, resilience, and a grounded perspective, often associated with maturity and quiet confidence. This color can promote a sense of peace and well-being, fostering an environment of understated elegance and thoughtful reflection.
